label: TMC2130 Stepper Demo
info: A small linear-axis controller. One Inject node sends {enable: true, current: 0.8, microsteps: 16} once at start. A second Inject node ticks every 5 s into a Function node that alternates {move: 400, speed: 200} and {move: -400, speed: 200}, so the TMC2130 moves forward and backward with software-timed STEP/DIR pulses. A third Inject node polls the driver status every 2 s (any other message); a Function node checks msg.payload.fault and raises a Node-RED warning when it is non-zero and a notice when sg_result drops below 100, while a Debug node shows every reply.
